# qovery_azure_credentials (Data Source)

Reads existing Qovery Azure credentials.

~> **Note:** Terraform cannot create Azure credentials: their setup runs scripts from the Qovery Console. Create them in the [Qovery Console](https://console.qovery.com), then read them with this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qovery_azure_credentials" "my_azure_credentials" {
  id              = "<azure_credentials_id>"
  organization_id = "<organization_id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the Azure credentials.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `azure_application_id` (String) Application (client) ID of the Azure application Qovery creates when it sets up the credentials.
- `azure_application_object_id` (String) Object ID of the Azure application Qovery creates when it sets up the credentials.
- `azure_subscription_id` (String) ID of the Azure subscription Qovery creates the AKS clusters in.
- `azure_tenant_id` (String) ID of the Azure tenant.
- `name` (String) Name of the Azure credentials.
